Reason for Mistake: Misclassified Da Nang’s region. Although WebSurfer correctly identified the museum’s city as Da Nang, the Planner concluded it was in Southern Vietnam and even mixed labels (“Miền Nam / Nam Trung Bộ”). Da Nang is in the South Central Coast, which belongs to Central Vietnam (Miền Trung). The Planner prematurely finalized the task without validating the city-to-region mapping, leading to an incorrect final answer.
